Privacy Policy

Last updated November 24, 2026

This site is run by Rob Reece of 5 Solas Marketing (“I”, “me”). This policy explains what I collect and what I do with it. Questions: rob@robcreece.com.

What I collect

  • Your name and email address, when you sign up for a free tool or my email list.
  • Purchase details (name, email, product, amount), when you buy. Your card details go to the payment processor, never to me.
  • Messages you send me, such as email replies.
  • Basic technical data your browser sends to any website, such as IP address and device type, handled by my hosting and email providers.

How I use it

  • To send you the free tool or product you asked for.
  • To email you tips and offers. Every email has an unsubscribe link and I honor it.
  • To answer your questions, process refunds and keep records.
  • To keep the site working and secure.

I do not sell your personal information.

Who handles your data

I use a few services to run the site. They process data only to provide their service to me:

  • Dodo Payments: checkout and payment processing.
  • Emailit: sign-up forms and email delivery.
  • Cloudflare and GitHub: website hosting and delivery.
  • YouTube: embedded videos. I use the privacy-enhanced embed, and YouTube loads only when you press play.

Cookies

I do not set advertising or tracking cookies on this site. Third-party services I use, such as the payment checkout, may set cookies they need to work.

How long I keep it

I keep email list data until you unsubscribe or ask me to delete it. I keep purchase and refund records as long as needed for taxes, accounting and legal reasons.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe from any email, and you can ask me to see, fix or delete your data by emailing rob@robcreece.com. If you are in a place with privacy laws that give you more rights (such as the EU, UK or California), I will honor those rights too.

Children

This site is for adults. I do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Changes

If I change this policy I will update the date above.
